_comment: Nine fox tails in one fan (C2; Yugen's), for a hero whose phase looks show them three, six and nine at a time (his source's phase looks hide and show their root bones): `tails/fox`'s tail, built nine times at the angles listed in build order. The first three (the middle one on the rig's tail_1..5, the two at +-37.5 degrees on coarser three-bone chains) are full detail; the other six (+-18.75, +-56.25, +-75) are level-of-detail copies, each on one fine_ bone (fine_tail_1_d .. fine_tail_1_i), so nine tails fit the bone and cube budgets and beyond the fine distance the fan falls back to the first three. Each copy is a little smaller (copy_scale) and has its own spring chain.
